description.narrative: Loadshare is an Indian logistics company that uses technology to bring together small and medium logistics companies to create a pan-Indian network reaching local suppliers and rural customers. By bringing together these smaller companies, Loadshare enables them to have better market access, which in turn boosts their growth and creates jobs.

This investment is part of our 'VC Scale-up' strategy to support the growth of the most impactful companies in our venture capital funds portfolio. We invested in the business in 2020 to support this growth and to create more jobs. Levels of unemployment are high in the markets where Loadshare operates, and we know that both the staff employed by the ?last mile? delivery partners and the truck drivers are typically low-income workers with limited prior access to formal employment. Our expectation is that these jobs will have a significant positive impact on earnings.
